about.header: I build machine learning systems by day and explain AI by night.
paragraphs: Hi, I'm Divyanshu. I'm a Senior Data Scientist and ML Engineer in automotive R&D, where I work on machine learning every day.

Outside work, I write about AI: how it's developing, how it works, and why it matters to the rest of us. Every Sunday I publish This Week in AI, a roundup of the three biggest stories, along with deeper articles on my Substack, The Briefing Point. I share shorter versions on LinkedIn in my newsletter, Divyanshu Decodes.
I'm also fascinated by geopolitics, so I make short, simple videos explaining world events on a separate YouTube channel.
